figures.caption: Stimulus of the SOA test over the whole transient (scope device, 5310 pairs).

Largest |Vgs|, |Vgd|, |Vds| of every checked device against the 1.1 V limit and the 1.29 V transient limit (at most 100 ps above 1.1 V in any 10 ns window; scope: device), the worst pair over the whole run, and the saved time points around the time of its maximum, which set the time resolution.
